meaning: per entry: a moat certificate of radius `moat_rho` (no legal unit square meets B(p,moat_rho), uniformly over the bin) and a list of closed rational rectangles inside B(p,R), R = rho_min/2, each certified PLANE-DEAD for the pair uniformly over the bin and each inside conv(a cup b) (Lemma K).  `charge` = sum of their areas.  Theorem A45.1: over any set of corner-type contacts of one packing, the charges of the bins they realise sum to <= s^2 - 11.

frames.WC: square a, lowest corner at p=(10,0) on the bottom wall of [0,20]^2; phi = tilt in (0,45] after the mirror reduction phi ~ 90-phi
frames.CE: a lowest corner at p=(10,10), tilt d; b upright, top edge on y=10, centre (10-u, 9.5); d in (0,45] and u in [-1/2,1/2] after the mirror reduction (d,u) ~ (90-d,-u)
frames.CC: NOT TABULATED: at a corner-corner contact the two bodies occupy 180 deg around p, so one free wedge is >= 90 deg and a legal unit square has a corner AT p; the moat fails at every radius.  All CC contacts are charged 0 (conservative).

convention.regions: `regions` are RELATIVE to the contact point p (x-px, y-py); `regions_frame` are the same rectangles in the certifier frame
convention.rationals: all numbers are exact rationals as strings
